$comment: Runtime configuration. Values here were magic literals scattered through the routes and the page component; changing a model or a cap should not require a code edit.

openai.$comment: One model per endpoint so any single call can be retargeted independently. All three were hard-coded to gpt-4o.
openai.$storeComment: Only the help route set `store: true`, to retain threads for continuity/analytics. Preserved per-endpoint rather than made uniform.

limits.$comment: maxPromptChars truncates the submitted work before it is embedded in the prompt, guarding the context window. historyEntries caps what is kept in localStorage; the UI copy says 'past 10 questions'.

storageKeys.$comment: localStorage keys. `history` is versioned so a future shape change can be introduced without misreading old records.

defaults.$comment: Initial state before any stored preference is read. theme is 'dark' because the design was built dark-first; the system colour-scheme preference is deliberately not consulted, matching existing behavior.
defaults.subject: cs
